description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to process management within an internal core module, including process information, configuration, and management operations such as start, stop, and status checks.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a running or managed process, such as PID, status, and command.

classes.name: ProcessConfig
classes.description: Contains configuration parameters required to start a new process.

classes.name: ProcessManager
classes.description: Interface for managing system processes (start, stop, monitor).

classes.name: PortManager
classes.description: Interface for managing network ports (finding, checking, reserving, releasing).

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a new process based on provided configuration, returning its PID or error.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a process identified by its PID, handling graceful or forceful termination.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Retrieves current status and info of a process by PID.

methods.name: FindFreePort
methods.description: Finds an available network port starting from a specified port.

methods.name: IsPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific network port is available.

methods.name: ReservePort
methods.description: Reserves a port for use within the application context.

methods.name: ReleasePort
methods.description: Releases a previously reserved port, making it available again.
